result.rationale: In EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents, the loop iterates each destination in event.destinationCalendar; in the else branch (destination without credentialId), it filters this.calendarCredentials by integration type and calls createEvent for every match. If two destinations share the same integration type and lack credentialId, the same credentials are matched twice, creating duplicate events on the same calendar — a fan-out duplication introduced by converting destinationCalendar to an array. The mechanism is verifiable directly in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` adds an `else` branch when a `destination` has no `credentialId`: it filters `this.calendarCredentials` by `c.type === destination.integration` and then creates an event for *each* matching credential (`Promise.all(... createEvent(c, event))`). Because this happens *inside the loop*, if `event.destinationCalendar` contains multiple entries with the same `integration` and missing `credentialId`, the same set of credentials will be processed repeatedly, causing duplicated external API calls and duplicated calendar events. This behavior is directly visible in the diff around the `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` change.
